'''Umbarra Plaza''' was a section of the [[Duros Sector]] of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The plaza was the site of [[Rana Mas Square]], and the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] maintained a [[Hutt Cartel safe house|safe house]] in the area.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Umbarra Plaza appears as part of the Duros Sector in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
